m_dialogEntries.m_dialog: <ITALICS>You rip away the Goblin Kudzu Vines. They are sharp, and sticky with a dark sap that stings. You clear enough to get to the tree. </ITALICS>
<ITALICS>You reach the Signal Horn and raise it to your lips. </ITALICS>\n
<ITALICS>The sound is low and long. It announces you are here, and also calls a challenge to Black Annie. </ITALICS>
<ITALICS>The sound echoes around the shore long after you lower the horn. A path reveals itself leading across the water. </ITALICS>
A visitor! So pretty! Your presence warms my sanguine heart! Now, I'll roast your heart on a spit!
Aiiyah! Petty, treacherous Wizard! May you face a thousand deaths! Take this blasted Iron Key, and be done with me!
<ITALICS>As you approach the Dolorous Tower, you feel the Seraph Guardian watching you closely. </ITALICS>
<ITALICS>She gives you a hint of a smile, indicating you should enter the Tower. </ITALICS>
A glorious Wizard and a Knight of the Wyrd... both in one. Truly this is a portentous day.
There is a Signal Horn hanging from a Tree, now covered and choked by Goblin Kudzu Vines! You'll have to rip the Vines away.
Once you see the Signal Horn, sound it to show you the path over Lake Nimue.
You'll have to deal with Black Annie. She holds the iron key to the Dolorous Tower. With it, you can enter and find the Lady.
Are you ready for this challenge?  Rip away the Goblin Kudzu Vines to reveal the Signal Horn. Sound it to reveal the hidden path.
Then head across the water to Black Annie's hut. Defeat her for the Iron Key, then enter the Dolorous Tower!
